items.title: The pushforward of an injective module is totally acyclic

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the pushforward of an injective module along a morphism of ringed topoi is totally acyclic (statement lines 2211-2218). The proof applies the criterion of the companion lemma: it tests the extended Cech complexes of f_*I against surjections of sheaves of sets on the target (proof lines 2220-2228), and then uses the pullback-pushforward adjunction together with injectivity of I to show that the higher cohomology of f_*I vanishes on every object, which by the criterion is total acyclicity (proof lines 2231-2247). The non-formal content is the transfer of the vanishing across the adjunction. The claim is H2: one criterion and one adjunction computation.
